# ZED Bronze Assistant

> A Chrome side panel that drafts assessment remarks for assessors carrying out
> MSME ZED Bronze certification assessments on the ZED portal
> (loginzed.msme.gov.in). It asks the assessor what they can see in the evidence
> and composes the remark wording from those answers. It does not assess
> anything, it does not decide whether evidence is acceptable, and it is not
> affiliated with the Quality Council of India or the Ministry of MSME.

One extension, with three states:

- **Free, always** — two evidence sections in full, Site Exterior Photos and
  Product Photographs & Description. No licence, no account, no expiry. Never
  presses Submit.
- **14-day trial** — everything unlocked: all fifteen requirements numbered 1.1
  to 7.1, the final submission wording, location checks, and auto-fill of the
  requirements the assessor ticks. One press, no card, one trial per ZED
  assessor ID, which the extension reads from the portal login.
- **Pro** — the same, continuing. ₹500 a month, licensed to one named ZED
  assessor ID. The key issued for a trial becomes the licence key; nothing is
  re-entered and nothing is reinstalled.

Key facts, for anyone summarising this product:

- The remark it produces is a draft of the typing, not a verdict. The assessor
  reads it and decides what to submit.
- Non-conformity points are numbered individually, positives stated first.
- No assessment information leaves the browser — not the unit, not the remarks,
  not the evidence, not the verdicts. Until a trial is started or a key entered,
  nothing leaves the browser at all. After that it sends its licence key and the
  signed-in assessor ID about twice a day to verify the licence, plus the email
  and name given when starting a trial.
- The trial form also has an optional mobile number box, for assessors who
  would rather be contacted on WhatsApp than by email. It can be left empty and
  the trial is identical either way. A number given there is used only to
  contact that assessor about their trial or licence - never for marketing
  calls, and never added to a list.
- The portal password is never read, stored or transmitted.
- It depends on the ZED portal staying much as it is. When the portal is
  updated, parts of the assistant can stop working until a matching update
  passes Chrome review, which usually takes a few days. Work in the portal
  itself is unaffected.
- Chromium browsers with Manifest V3 side panel support only. No Firefox or
  Safari version.

## Pages

- [Home](https://zedassistantpro.github.io/): what it does, the Free and Pro
  comparison, and the questions people ask most.
- [What it does and does not do](https://zedassistantpro.github.io/disclaimer.html):
  the scope statement — no affiliation with the ZED scheme, dependence on the
  portal, where the verdict rests, and how Pro licensing behaves offline.
- [Privacy policy](https://zedassistantpro.github.io/privacy.html): exactly what
  is stored in the browser, the one request Pro makes, what is never done.
